originalFindings.title: Near-duplicate teacher/student role frames supply both context keys
originalFindings.claim: reading-assignment and class-cleaning are not genuinely different role-assignment contexts in the causative-roles and cp-roles groups. They retain the same teacher/student participants, topic/actor/object order, case frame, past polarity, requested role and answer mapping; only the lexical task/object changes.
originalFindings.impact: Twelve correct questions provide useful paired repetition, but all six role facets lack a genuinely different second role context under the contract. Separate strings can overstate context coverage/familiarity. This is not a wrong sentence or answer key, and it does not invalidate distinct verb-class formation operations elsewhere.
originalFindings.remedy: Replace one repeated role-template family with genuinely varied role contexts, or otherwise meet the two-context requirement without counting lexical substitutions as transfer. Preserve genuine pairing; recheck codes, feedback, keys, vocabulary bindings and coverage declarations. Renaming/merging alone exposes but does not fill the gap.
